content.simple_explanation: Learn Temperature and its Measurement by understanding the main idea, evidence/examples and how to apply it.
key_points: — Anna Mani Lambok and his elder sister Phiban live in Shillong.
Their parents were away at work and Lambok complained that he was feeling feverish.
Phiban touched his forehead and felt that he might be having a fever.
To confirm this, she took out the thermometer kept in the almirah.
She washed its tip with soap and water, and measured Lambok’s temperature.
